corrected_initial_typecheck.reason: The generic ReturnType of overloaded vi.fn included a constructable mock; the context now accepts RuntimeClient.call directly. Final CLI typecheck passes.

limitations: All twenty-two declarations and both explicit remote-environment table rows remain, expanding to twenty-three runtime cases.
Real temporary unit, launcher and brake files ran on Linux; injected launchctl/systemctl/loginctl dependencies establish command construction and parsing, not native manager integration.
The service-launcher title is corrected to profile skip and bare Linux CLI refusal; no mounted-AppImage input or coverage is claimed.
Speech stdin tests cover concatenation, trimming, TTY, blank and post-read character overflow; they do not establish the early streaming-byte cap.
Skill sharing uses a mocked runtime RPC. No actual publish, upload, credential use, socket or app launch occurred.
Supporting source reads do not complete reviews of other pending tests.
